scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run start -w api" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npx -w web tsc --noEmit
